title: Atlas story node: region
description: One entry of content/story/regions.json. Part of the F-012 per-kind story graph (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-22-epic-story-pipeline-design.md). F-041: spineId is the foreign key into content/spine/nodes/. Plan E ruling 7b (owner, 2026-08-26; STATE §28): after the redraw retires most town-tier nodes, a region may instead carry resolvedRef — an id from the resolved world's zones ∪ towns — with exactly one of the two present. Resolution, uniqueness and tier printing remain G-ALIAS (story half) in scripts/check_content.mjs.
